meta.title: Sekai bridge
meta.description: Sekai router/worker bridge plugins for dsh: drives sekai-router --serve (JSONL over stdio) and the sekai-worker connect lifecycle (PC agent with prompt relaying and opt-in virtual GPIO). The worker plugin's autoConnect switch decides whether DSH startup reconnects to the last connected router (persisted per workerId), and sekai_worker_connect / sekai_worker_disconnect control the connection on demand; sekai_* tools are published.
